### priority_rules
# P1: service-wide or security-critical incidents
if contains "outage" -> P1
if contains "is down" -> P1
if contains "went down" -> P1
if contains "data loss" -> P1
if contains "breach" -> P1
if contains "security" and not contains "question" -> P1
if contains "all users" and contains "down" -> P1

# P2: money, delivery, or access problems that block the customer
if contains "refund" -> P2
if contains "double charge" -> P2
if contains "charged twice" -> P2
if contains "overcharged" -> P2
if contains "lost my" -> P2
if contains "never arrived" -> P2
if contains "not delivered" -> P2
if contains "damaged" -> P2
if contains "replacement" -> P2
if contains "locked out" -> P2
if contains "nobody can" -> P2
if contains "can't log in" -> P2
if contains "cannot log in" -> P2
if contains "unable to access" -> P2
if queue == account and contains "urgent" and not contains "question" -> P2
if queue == shipping and not contains "how do" -> P2
if queue == billing and not contains "question" and not contains "invoice" -> P2

# P3: how-to questions, cosmetic issues, and everything else
default -> P3
